## Rule

**Quadrant replication.** The grid is divided by full color-4 (yellow) lines into a `width × 2` array of 9×9 quadrants (ARC-GEN `task_c444b776`: `height=2` fixed, `width∈{1,2,3}`, `size=9` ⇒ grids are 19 rows × {9,19,29} cols, embedded top-left in the 30×30 canvas). Exactly ONE quadrant contains content (colors 1-9 on a color-0 background); the output copies that content into ALL quadrants at the same in-quadrant offset. Dividers (color 4) and padding are preserved. See `prototypes/task306_numpy_reference.py` (265/265).

## Algorithm sketch (as implemented by the SHIPPED parent — what Path A must replicate)

Panels are `[10R:10R+9] × [10C:10C+9]`, R∈{0,1}, C∈{0,1,2}. Output = input with up to 6 panels overwritten by `selected_source` (the content quadrant):
- `selected_source = Σ_RC present[R,C]·panel[R,C]`, where `present[R,C] = (ReduceSum(ch0 of panel) < 81)` = panel has a non-background cell. (On overlapping/random inputs multiple panels are present and the parent SUMS them ⇒ multi-channel cells; the grader thresholds via `(out>0)`.)
- `div_col1_exists = Σ(ch4 of col 9, rows 0-18) > 0`; `div_col2_exists` likewise for col 19.
- Panels (0,0)&(1,0) (cols 0-8) ALWAYS get `selected_source`; cols 10-18 get it iff `div_col1_exists` else the original panel; cols 20-28 iff `div_col2_exists`.
- Row 9, cols 9/19/29 (dividers + tail) and rows 19-29 (bottom) pass through from input.

## Cost analysis

**Cost model (from `neurogolf_utils.calculate_memory`):** `cost = memory + params`, where `memory` is the SUM over every intermediate tensor of `num_elements × dtype.itemsize` (shape-inferred, max'd with the ORT profiler trace), **excluding only the named `input` and `output`**. So the final op producing `output` and the `input` are FREE; every other node output is counted at full size. `params` = total initializer element count.

**Parent (LIVE, 65,826)** per-tensor breakdown — f16 (2B) everywhere:
- `input16` `[1,10,30,30]` f16 = **18,000B** — the single full-canvas cast (every Slice reads it).
- `bottom_tail` `[1,10,11,30]` = 6,600; `top_band`/`bot_band` `[1,10,9,30]` = 5,400 each (2-D concat reconstruction).
- 15× `[1,10,9,9]` f16 (6 src panels + 6 selected + SS + 4 blocks... ) = 1,620B each ≈ 24,300.
- counts/masks/ch0/div slices ≈ 5,600.

**Levers applied (v1/v2):** the data is one-hot {0,1}, so f16→**uint8** halves every data tensor; the grader decodes via `(out>0)` so `Sum→Max` and `Mul→Where` are threshold-exact (`max{0,1}=OR=threshold(sum)`); `input16` 18,000→`xb` uint8 9,000. v2 additionally drops the 6 `sel` tensors via the channel-split (present mask redundant for c≥1).

**v2 residual breakdown (30,245):** `xb` 9,000 + `bottom_tail` 3,300 + 2 bands 5,400 + 6 src panels 4,860 + 4 blocks 3,240 + (max_all 810 + SS_hi 729 + SS 810 + sel0 486 + SS_lo 81) + passthrough cols/row_div ~840 + ch0 486 + control ~100 + params 149.

### Path B (v5, 8,538) — escapes the 10-channel plumbing entirely

The exact-Path-A floor (~30K) is bounded by the 10-channel one-hot I/O (a uint8 source canvas + 10-channel reconstruction ≈ 18K). **Path B sidesteps it by doing all work in a single-channel color index**, then expanding back to one-hot only at the free output:
- collapse `[1,10,30,30]`→`[1,1,30,30]` color index (`Conv`, **3,600B** f32 — the new floor, the only "wide" tensor),
- replicate in single-channel uint8 (fold `[1,1,3,10,3,10]`+`ReduceMax`=1,000; tile=900; masks=1,800),
- expand `Equal(idx,colors[10,1,1])` → output **free** (broadcast; no OneHot/int32 round-trip).

v5 breakdown (8,500 mem): `idx_f` 3,600 + `idxu` 900 + `rq` 900 + `canon` 100 + `rep` 900 + 2 masks 1,800 + row/col reduces+greaters 300. The `Conv` f32 (3,600) is irreducible (ORT `Conv` outputs f32; `ArgMax` would be int64=7,200; quantized paths need a 9,000B uint8 input). **8,538 is the practical color-index floor.**

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them._

- **The prompt's "≤4,500 floor" is NOT reachable via exact Path A (byte-equal).** Proven by decomposition: the output is 10-channel one-hot `[1,10,30,30]`, and on overlapping inputs the parent emits a SUM of one-hot quadrants → MULTIPLE channels set per cell (decodes to color 11). Measured: on the random adversarial family **6,856/8,000 inputs have parent values >1** (genuine multi-quadrant overlap). To stay byte-/threshold-equal you must carry all 10 channels through the overlay. A 10-channel uint8 canvas alone is 9,000B; the 2-D concat reconstruction adds ~9.5K (bands 5,400 + bottom-rows passthrough 3,300 — rows 19-29 carry content for random h up to 24, so they can NOT be cropped); content-extraction + conditional blocks add ~9.6K. **Exact-Path-A floor ≈ 28-30K.** v2 (30,245) is at ~1.0-1.1× of it.
- **Color-index / single-channel collapse: FAILS Path-A (parent byte-equal) but SUCCEEDS as Path B (v5).** A single color-index channel cannot encode the multi-channel "color 11" overlap cells the parent produces on synthetic multi-quadrant inputs → 0/500 vs parent on `adversarial_against_live` (a Path-A gate). BUT on the REAL task distribution every grid has exactly one content quadrant, so the color-index solver is byte-exact vs GROUND TRUTH (21,271/21,271 fresh). v5 (8,538, +2.04 LB) is this solver. **Do not judge a Path-B candidate with `adversarial_against_live` (it compares to the parent's quirk); judge it vs ARC-GEN `generate()` ground-truth output.**
- **Path-B v5 SHIP STRATEGY / RISK (captain):** v5 assumes the task_c444b776 structure (height=2 quadrants=19 rows, size-9 quadrants at stride 10, single content quadrant, dividers at boundaries) — which the ARC-GEN generator hard-codes, so v5 is correct on the hidden ARC-GEN private set. Upside +2.04 LB; downside if the hidden set somehow violates the structure = task drops to 0 (−13.9 LB). Mitigation: ship v5 as a **monitored wildcard**, observe LB next day, revert task306→v2 (or parent) if it regresses (5/day budget covers this). v2 (+0.78, byte-equal, zero-risk) is the safe fallback. This is a novel-op rewrite of a SOLVED task (traps.md hard-constraint) — but unlike the documented 0-LB failures it is verified correct vs ground truth (not visible-fit) and uses arithmetic-clean uint8 (not F16).
- **Tile/Pad-to-canvas reconstruction (`out = Where(mask, Tile(Pad(SS)), xb)`) is WORSE than concat-bands**, not better: building a full `[1,10,30,30]` content canvas costs ~9,000 + ~6,600 tiling intermediates, vs concat-bands' 5,400 overhead. The free `output` is best fed by a Concat of small pieces, not a Where over full-canvas operands.
- **Staying in f32 (no cast) to kill `input16` is worse**: removes 18,000 but doubles every other intermediate (f16→f32) → ~95K. The parent's f16 choice is already good; the only way below f16 is uint8, which requires changing ops (see novel-op note).
- **Novel-op-chain caution (traps.md §"NOVEL OP CHAIN RULE"):** v1/v2 introduce `Max`/`Where`/`ReduceMin`/`ReduceMax` not in the parent's vocabulary. This pattern has scored 0 LB on the grader when the rewrite was visible-fit or used F16 *arithmetic*. Here it is mitigated to the v40-success standard: UINT8 binary (no F16 arithmetic precision risk, §527 "empirically clean"), exact replication of the SHIPPED rule, and **RAW byte-equal on the ARC-GEN/hidden distribution (8000/8000) + THRESHOLD-equal on 16,000 fresh-seed A/B inputs**. Captain: prefer v1 if you want the most conservative (minimal structural delta) ship; v2 is the same op vocabulary with a lower cost.
- ReduceSum(uint8) and ReduceMin/Max(uint8) at opset ≤13 are rejected by ORT 1.24.4 (`INVALID_GRAPH`); **opset 18 is required** for `ReduceMin/Max(uint8)` (verified). `Max(uint8)` works at opset 12+.
- **Cropping the input before the `Conv` to shrink `idx_f` (the 3,600 B f32) is a NET LOSS — DEAD-END (measured v6 2026-05-31).** The Conv collapse output `idx_f [1,1,30,30] f32` is 42% of v5's memory, but it is IRREDUCIBLE: shrinking it requires a spatially-smaller Conv input, and `Slice(input)` operates on the **10-channel f32** input → materializes a counted intermediate `xc [1,10,19,29] f32 = 22,040 B` that dwarfs the ~1,396 B the smaller `idx_f` saves. Measured cost **32,797** (vs 8,538), a +24k regression (`build_task306_crop_test.{py,onnx}`). No single op collapses 10 f32 channels to <3,600 (ArgMax int64=7,200; Mul→ReduceSum has a 36k Mul intermediate; quantized/ConvInteger needs a 9k u8 input). **The front half (idx_f 3600 + idxu 900 + rq 900 + canon 100 = 5,500) is the irreducible color-index floor** — and Cast-to-u8 MUST precede the fold Reshape (reshaping the f32 costs 3,600, not 900).
- **The realistic v6 floor is ~7,789, NOT the prompt's hoped 5,500–6,500.** The 5,500–6,500 estimate assumed cropping `idx_f` works (it doesn't, see above) and that more u8 tensors could vanish. After restructuring (v6/B2): front 5,500 (irreducible) + back ≈ 1,920 mem + a 330-element sentinel-rows init (the 11×30 padding rows 19–29 cost 330 as init OR memory — unavoidable in any approach that feeds the FREE `Equal` output a full `[1,1,30,30]` u8). The merge-two-Wheres-into-one (`And(row,col)`) lever is **net-zero** (the combined BOOL mask is the same 900 B as the `m1` it removes). `cmax` (col presence) MUST come from `ReduceMax(INPUT)` not the index — an all-background in-grid column has index 0 but is real, so an index-based presence check wrongly masks it.
- **Superseded 2026-06-11:** the one-Conv tie was not a floor. Deep free-output Einsum v3 reaches 1,300; v2 shared-basis attempt was visible-clean but `score_network_v2` rejected duplicate Einsum initializer inputs.
- **300 IS THE FLOOR — rank-1 bank is mathematically impossible (w20, 2026-06-24).** Team-best fell from 1,300 (our v3) to **300** (Aditya, 2026-06-19) = a SINGLE shared `[10,30]` F32 modulo basis (300 params, zero charged intermediates; `spread_score_isolated` now accepts the 4× duplicate-init Einsum, so the old `score_network_v2`-None blocker is gone — sharing the basis is what reaches 400-with-M / 300-without-M). The prompt's `v_row[30] ⊗ v_col[30]` ≈ 60-param rank-1 hypothesis **cannot exist**: the modulo basis is **rank 10** (`matrix_rank==10`), so it is not any outer product. Its exact low-param factorization is `kron(ones(1,3), I10)`, but the identity-free part needs a 6-D Reshape of the input → a **36,000-byte charged intermediate**, which is 120× worse than the 300-param basis it would replace. Zero-intermediate is the entire reason this family wins; no reshape route survives. **params count ELEMENTS, not bytes** → the rank-10 `[10,30]=300` cannot shrink via dtype either. Below 300 would also be a near-zero EV move (points = 25 − ln(cost): 300→299 is only +0.0033 pts). 4th no_candidate on this task (after beta_p7f, beta_p7p, alpha_p4_native). **STOP retrying sub-300 on task306.**
